facts.event: Tris 凑近偷听，只接到 Jove 对 Evelyn 的末句“你也许该补偿他”，Evelyn 答“记下了”，随即补一句“不过那值得”。
facts.text:
“—might want to make it up to him.”



“Noted,” Evelyn replies. “It was worth it, though.”



I’m sure she’s talking about the attack on the detention facility.

facts.event: Evelyn 把 Tris 借出餐厅、带进隧道通到隔壁空楼，说要她帮忙给一个“recruit”出主意；Tris 诧异她也招人，Evelyn 说通常不招，但会让不快乐的人知道还有别的选择。
facts.text:
“Advice. For a recruit.”



“A recruit?” I say. “I didn’t know you . . . recruited.”




“Not usually. But as you can imagine, we can use all the help we can get.

facts.event: Tris 只给出“你不能逼他，你只要听”，被 Evelyn 一句冷笑顶回；她随即改口自荐：他不肯跟她说，也许肯跟我谈，Evelyn 当场应下“也许他会”。
facts.text: “Then send someone else,” I say. “If he won’t talk to you . . . maybe he’d talk to me.”

facts.event: 两人不回合 Rookery，走到 Quincy 站台上车；Evelyn 交代对方会先上车别惊慌，并说他“叫 Four，Dauntless 的绰号”。
facts.text:
“He goes by Four. Dauntless nickname.”



Four. I wonder why a Dauntless boy would have a number for a name.

facts.event: Tris 在车厢里认出这个 recruit 正是 Choosing Ceremony 上扶她起身的 sentry，而他眼里没有半点认出她的意思。
facts.text:
He’s the sentry who helped me at the Choosing Ceremony.



I stare at him, suddenly tongue-tied, and the train turns, shuddering on its rails as it switches to the elevated track.

facts.event: Four 一口回绝，断言是 Evelyn 派她来游说他叛派，并说“我肯定也是她的主意，她让你以为是你自己的”。
facts.text: “No. Absolutely not.” He paces away from me. “She sent you here to talk me into something, and I’m not interested.”

facts.event: Tris 拿“我说点新的、你听完，不成你下一站就下车”换来的二十秒里，讲“你选错了派系……你以为只有你在假装”；车过站，Four 没有跳下去。
facts.text: “You chose the wrong faction, or you think you did,” I say. “You don’t quite fit no matter where you are.

facts.event: Four 只留一句“告诉她我会考虑”，随即跳下车厢落在站台上消失；此前他说 Evelyn“猜了一次，猜对了”。
facts.text:
“She took a guess, and she guessed right.”



The train is slowing again. Four grabs the handle next to the door while I’m still too stunned to respond.

relations: Evelyn↔Four：她亲自出面试图招募他叛派；他断言她只是把他当工具（“you thought she’d make a good tool”），并承认“she guessed right”。
Evelyn↔Tris：Evelyn 以“I need your help”把她借走，Tris 主动加码（自荐去谈）以换取她的信任。
Jove↔Evelyn：Jove 私下提醒她“might want to make it up to him”，Evelyn 认下但说“It was worth it”。
Tris↔Four：单向旧识——她记得 Choosing Ceremony 上他扶她起身，他完全不记得她。
Tris↔Rory：Tris 试探“是不是在庆祝胜利”，Rory 一脸茫然“什么胜利”，说明越狱并未在 Rookery 公开。
Mender→Mae（次要）：他把睡着的 Mae 抱上楼。
numbers: “a few hours later”（回到 Rookery 的时间）
“Four”（Dauntless 的绰号，她当时不知其来历）
